server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Public room name shown in the server browser and Steam server list.

world_save_name.title: World Save Name
world_save_name.description: Folder name used under Saved/SaveGames/Server/Worlds. LanGame defaults this to the instance ID so multiple servers never share Cascade by accident.

max_server_players.title: Max Players
max_server_players.description: Player slot cap. Officially supports 1 to 24, but the dedicated server warns above 6.

server_password.title: Server Password
server_password.description: Join password for the room. Leave blank for open access.

admin_password.title: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Password used in-game to elevate into admin mode. Separate from the join password.

moderator_steam_ids.title: Moderator Steam64 IDs
moderator_steam_ids.description: One 17-digit Steam64 ID per line. LanGame writes these into Admin.ini as [Moderators] entries for passwordless Steam admin access.

lan_only.title: LAN Only
lan_only.description: Broadcast the server only on LAN discovery instead of exposing it for normal internet listing.

platform_limited.title: Platform Limit
platform_limited.description: Restrict the room to a single platform family instead of allowing full crossplay.

use_local_ips.title: Use Local IPs
use_local_ips.description: Also bind to local LAN addresses. Helpful for same-network joins, but the official docs note that it can interfere with internet discovery.

game_difficulty.title: Difficulty
game_difficulty.description: Controls baseline enemy presence, aggression, and combat pressure for the whole world.

hardcore_mode.title: Hardcore Mode
hardcore_mode.description: Scientists only get one life and the world is forced to Apocalyptic difficulty.

allow_iron_mode.title: Allow IronMode Starting Job
allow_iron_mode.description: Make the IronMode starting job available; Hardcore must also be enabled.

day_night_cycle_state.title: Day / Night State
day_night_cycle_state.description: Lock the world into day, night, or the normal full cycle.

day_night_cycle_speed_multiplier.title: Day / Night Speed
day_night_cycle_speed_multiplier.description: How quickly the in-world clock moves. This does not speed up unrelated cooldowns.

weather_frequency.title: Weather Frequency
weather_frequency.description: How often weather events are allowed to trigger once the world progression supports them.

first_time_starting_weapon.title: First-Time Starting Weapon
first_time_starting_weapon.description: Bonus starter weapon for newly spawned scientists in addition to their job kit.

home_worlds.title: Allow Home Worlds
home_worlds.description: Let this world access Home World portals, including DLC or event worlds such as Torii.

allow_character_reset.title: Allow Character Reset
allow_character_reset.description: Keep late-game reset methods available for jobs, skills, and traits.

base_inventory_size.title: Base Inventory Size
base_inventory_size.description: Default inventory slots when no backpack is equipped.

loot_respawn_enabled.title: Loot Respawn
loot_respawn_enabled.description: Allow facility resources to respawn over time. Furniture does not respawn.

sink_refill_rate.title: Sink Refill Rate
sink_refill_rate.description: How quickly sinks refill with drinkable water. Zero disables refill entirely.

food_spoil_speed_multiplier.title: Food Spoil Speed
food_spoil_speed_multiplier.description: How quickly food decays toward rotten food.

refrigeration_effectiveness_multiplier.title: Refrigeration Effectiveness
refrigeration_effectiveness_multiplier.description: How strongly refrigerators and other temperature-safe storage slow spoilage or preserve heat.

item_stack_size_multiplier.title: Item Stack Size
item_stack_size_multiplier.description: Multiplier for stackable item counts per inventory slot.

item_weight_multiplier.title: Item Weight
item_weight_multiplier.description: Multiplier for how heavy inventory items feel. Lower than 1 makes items lighter.

item_durability_multiplier.title: Item Durability
item_durability_multiplier.description: Multiplier for total durability on tools, weapons, and gear.

storage_by_tag.title: Storage By Item Tag
storage_by_tag.description: Keep container type restrictions such as refrigerators only accepting food.

tainted_sink_water.title: Tainted Sink Water
tainted_sink_water.description: Turn normally clean sink-style water sources into tainted water for a harsher survival loop.

damage_to_allies_multiplier.title: Ally Damage
damage_to_allies_multiplier.description: How much damage players deal to other players. 1.0 means full damage, 0.5 means half damage.

hunger_speed_multiplier.title: Hunger Speed
hunger_speed_multiplier.description: How quickly hunger rises for scientists.

thirst_speed_multiplier.title: Thirst Speed
thirst_speed_multiplier.description: How quickly thirst rises for scientists.

fatigue_speed_multiplier.title: Fatigue Speed
fatigue_speed_multiplier.description: How quickly fatigue builds up and drives players toward sleep.

continence_speed_multiplier.title: Continence Drain Multiplier
continence_speed_multiplier.description: Higher values make players need the toilet more often.

bonus_perk_points.title: Bonus Perk Points
bonus_perk_points.description: Extra perk points layered on top of the selected job's normal allotment. Negative values remove points.

player_xp_gain_multiplier.title: Player XP Gain
player_xp_gain_multiplier.description: How quickly players gain experience. Zero disables skill leveling entirely.

durability_loss_on_death_multiplier.title: Durability Loss On Death
durability_loss_on_death_multiplier.description: How much durability is stripped from carried gear after respawning.

show_death_messages.title: Show Death Messages
show_death_messages.description: Announce when scientists are killed by enemies or hazards.

allow_recipe_sharing.title: Allow Recipe Sharing
allow_recipe_sharing.description: Let scientists share unlocked recipes with each other.

allow_pagers.title: Allow Pagers
allow_pagers.description: Keep pagers usable from inventory and the emote wheel for player coordination.

allow_transmog.title: Allow Transmog
allow_transmog.description: Let players transmogrify armor appearances for cosmetics and disguise.

disable_research_minigame.title: Disable Research Minigame
disable_research_minigame.description: Skip the research minigame and unlock new recipes immediately.

death_penalties.title: Death Penalties
death_penalties.description: What items players keep or lose after death or using Unstick.

host_access_player_corpses.title: Host Access To Death Bags
host_access_player_corpses.description: Let the host access items inside player death bags.

enemy_spawn_rate.title: Enemy Respawn Rate
enemy_spawn_rate.description: How quickly enemies repopulate cleared spaces.

enemy_player_damage_multiplier.title: Enemy Damage To Players
enemy_player_damage_multiplier.description: Multiplier for how hard enemies hit scientists.

enemy_deployable_damage_multiplier.title: Enemy Damage To Deployables
enemy_deployable_damage_multiplier.description: Multiplier for damage dealt to bases, furniture, and other deployables.

detection_speed_multiplier.title: Enemy Detection Speed
detection_speed_multiplier.description: How quickly enemies notice scientists once they enter detection range.

enemy_accuracy.title: Enemy Accuracy
enemy_accuracy.description: Average shot grouping precision for ranged enemies.

apocalyptic_abilities.title: Apocalyptic Abilities
apocalyptic_abilities.description: Allow enemies to use their Apocalyptic abilities at any world difficulty.

maximize_enemy_spawns.title: Maximize Enemy Spawns
maximize_enemy_spawns.description: Enable every enemy spawn point regardless of world difficulty or player count.

invisible_radiation.title: Invisible Radiation
invisible_radiation.description: Hide the normal radiation screen effects so players need a Geiger Counter to spot danger.

radiation_deals_damage.title: Radiation Deals Damage
radiation_deals_damage.description: Make radiation actively damage health instead of only applying environmental pressure.

power_sockets_off_at_night.title: Power Sockets Off At Night
power_sockets_off_at_night.description: Keep facility power sockets disabled during the night cycle like the default game.

structural_support_limit.title: Furniture Stack Limit
structural_support_limit.description: Maximum number of furniture pieces that may be stacked on one another; 0 removes the limit.

bridge_supports.title: Bridge Support Requirement
bridge_supports.description: How much extra support bridges need beyond their initial placement point.

player_furniture_destruction.title: Destroy Player Furniture At Zero Durability
player_furniture_destruction.description: Permanently destroy player-built furniture when its durability reaches zero.

use_perf_threads.title: Use Performance Threads
use_perf_threads.description: Append the recommended -useperfthreads launch flag when starting the server.

disable_async_loading_thread.title: Disable Async Loading Thread
disable_async_loading_thread.description: Append the official -DisableAsyncLoadingThread launch flag. The docs no longer recommend this for most servers.
